items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Mr. Reese, Reese Scovette(?), he'd play his saxophone... Reese Scovette(?) played the bass, and that's the band they had.

ctx.x: His name was Alexander Augustine. And my cousin Clarice was working for some people, and they gave her a piano. Well, her place was too small for a piano, because it was one of these big concert pianos. And my mother, she had a great big room. So she had to give the piano to my mother, because she couldn't fit it in her house. And that's how my brother learned to play the piano. items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Mr. Reese's father used to play the bass on the table with the broomstick... Reese Scovette(?) played the bass, and that's the band they had.

ctx.x: Yes. But Mr. Reese's father used to play the bass on the table with the broomstick, with his finger. He would rub that stick across his finger and play the bass. Reese Scovette(?) played the bass, and that's the band they had. And then my mother or my father, they'd be singing or playing the comb. They'd put some grade(?) paper... At that time they'd put grade(?) paper on that comb or put some cigarette paper on the comb, and blow it across.
